slices.title: Control Prometheus rules for existing metrics
slices.summary: Adds audit-core alert rules for metrics that already exist (authority mismatch, store error, malformed, consumer pending above zero for 15 m, NATS disconnected for 5 m) in a new rules file with its promtool unit test. The rule_files glob and the rules mount already landed in 2f8b8caa, so S0 adds only the two new files and must not add a second rule_files key.
test_commands: docker run --rm --entrypoint promtool -v "$PWD/apps/Control Plane/observability:/o" prom/prometheus:v2.54.1 check rules /o/rules/audit-core.rules.yml

slices.title: ADR, canonical encoding library, audit-core CI
slices.summary: Records the ADR and builds the pure Go chain package: row hash v1 (VAC1, length-prefixed fields, per-org genesis), the VAH1 attestation and VAK1 checkpoint signed payloads, golden vectors, and the audit-core CI workflow (Postgres 16, go vet, go test, promtool check rules). No runtime change.

slices.title: Serialised per-org chained insert
slices.summary: Chains new audit rows per org inside insertAudit: a head row locked FOR UPDATE, with chain_seq, prev_hash and row_hash written in the same transaction, plus a guard trigger on UPDATE and DELETE, a boot catch-up for rows before activation (chain_mode catchup), and the chain metrics. Off by default behind AUDIT_CHAIN_ENABLED; rows before activation stay legacy_unchained with no backfill.
test_commands: cd "apps/Control Plane/audit-core" && TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:t@localhost:55432/postgres?sslmode=disable" go vet ./... && go test ./...

slices.title: Signed head attestations and chain-safe retention
slices.summary: Adds Ed25519 signed head attestations and checkpoints and makes Purge chain-safe: per org in 5k-row batches it verifies the prefix before deleting, writes a signed checkpoint per batch, and on verify failure writes an incident and deletes nothing. Chained-row pruning stays off behind AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_ENABLED (default 0), with a dry-run mode; boot fails without a key in production. Appendix B.4: needs more than the 5-7 d range; no figure is given.
slices.needs_external: DEC-35 D1 owner ruling (trust anchor: Ed25519 key in env plus an external witness) gates the slice. Production key custody and rotation are an operator action outside the code.
slices.flag: AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_ENABLED (default 0); AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_DRYRUN; key env AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY_ID, AUDIT_CHAIN_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64, AUDIT_CHAIN_PUBLIC_KEY_BASE64, AUDIT_CHAIN_VERIFY_KEYS, AUDIT_CHAIN_ATTEST_INTERVAL
test_commands: cd "apps/Control Plane/audit-core" && TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:t@localhost:55432/postgres?sslmode=disable" go vet ./... && go test ./...

slices.title: Verifier, offline CLI, chain alerts
slices.summary: Adds VerifyOrg (latest checkpoint signature, prev-hash chain, contiguous chain_seq, recomputed row hashes, head and truncation checks, attestation signature), a daily incremental and weekly full verifier loop with metrics and alerts, and the offline cmd/audit-verify CLI (exit 0 verified, 2 broken, 3 unverifiable). Reports verified, verified_with_legacy, broken, partial or key_unavailable, never a bare ok.

slices.flag: AUDIT_CHAIN_VERIFY_ENABLED (default 1 when the chain is on); AUDIT_CHAIN_VERIFY_INTERVAL

slices.title: org-core SIEM destination config
slices.summary: Adds SIEM destination config to org-core: a migration with RLS (max 3 destinations per org), AES-256-GCM sealed write-only secrets under ORG_CORE_SIEM_SEAL_KEY, owner and admin CRUD at /orgs/:id/siem-destinations, and an internal exporter read. Adds the org:siem:manage:self and org:siem:read:any scopes, the feature.siem_export computed gate and a durable audit row per change; routes return 404 until ORG_SIEM_DESTINATIONS_ENABLED=1.

slices.flag: ORG_SIEM_DESTINATIONS_ENABLED (default 0; routes 404); ORG_CORE_SIEM_SEAL_KEY with a key id (secret)

slices.title: SIEM exporter service
slices.summary: Adds a separate siem-exporter binary in audit-core that polls org-core every 30 s, reads each enabled destination's chain in order (500 rows per batch, cursor advanced on 2xx only) and delivers NDJSON or Splunk HEC with HMAC signing and a gap marker. The egress guard allows https only, blocks private ranges at dial time, follows no redirects and caps at 10 s and 1 MiB. Runs only under compose profile siem, with AUDIT_SIEM_EXPORT_ENABLED=0 by default.
slices.needs_external: DEC-35 D4 owner ruling (separate siem-exporter binary) gates the slice. The S7 commercial gate must be ruled before the exporter is enabled outside dev.
slices.flag: AUDIT_SIEM_EXPORT_ENABLED (default 0; the binary idles); AUDIT_SIEM_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DESTINATIONS (dev only, refused when ENVIRONMENT=production)
